name: Santorini
tagline: Blue domes, white stairs and caldera sunsets.
description: The Greek island classic: Oia's blue domes, whitewashed stairs with bougainvillea, cliffside breakfasts, windmills, Ammoudi Bay tavernas, a sailboat across the caldera and candlelit terraces after dark. Breezy linen and dazzling Aegean light.
